gen_risks.description: CRM system not delivered by November 2025, delaying onboarding of cohort 1 schools.
gen_risks.mitigation: Allocate a dedicated development team, set weekly milestones, conduct early user testing, and prepare a manual onboarding fallback process.
gen_risks.evidence: develop a customer relationship management system internally, working towards a minimum-viable product from November 2025.

gen_risks.description: Call‑centre pilot for data collection may encounter implementation problems, affecting data quality.
gen_risks.mitigation: Pilot the call centre in a limited region, establish clear SOPs, and have alternative data capture methods ready.
gen_risks.evidence: start commercial processes to begin a call-centre pilot to support data collection.

gen_risks.description: Insufficient physical space in some schools could prevent delivery of the 30‑minute breakfast club.
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage technical estate advisers early to assess space, provide guidance on reconfiguring areas or using temporary modular units.
gen_risks.evidence: technical estate advisers to test what schools can do to mitigate any space constraints.

gen_risks.description: Delay in obtaining timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury could postpone programme start.
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage Treasury early, submit a detailed business case, and secure provisional funding commitments.
gen_risks.evidence: timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury

gen_risks.description: Limited availability of skilled staff and resources in DfE and the education sector may hinder delivery.
gen_risks.mitigation: Recruit additional staff, provide targeted training, and supplement with contracted specialist advisers.
gen_risks.evidence: availability of skilled staff and resources, in both DfE and the education sector

gen_risks.description: Potential gap in breakfast provision for schools transitioning from the NSBP after its July 2026 closure.
gen_risks.mitigation: Coordinate transition timelines, guarantee places for NSBP schools, and offer interim support during handover.
gen_risks.evidence: guaranteed a place to ensure they do not have a gap in provision after the closure of the NSBP in July 2026

gen_risks.description: Delay in enactment of the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Bill could affect the mandatory duty timing.
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor legislative progress, develop interim guidance, and align rollout dates with expected enactment.
gen_risks.evidence: Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill will place a duty on state-funded schools

gen_risks.description: Confusion over the funding model, especially previous disadvantage‑level variations, may reduce school participation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide clear, simplified guidance, run webinars, and set up a helpdesk to answer queries.
gen_risks.evidence: variation by disadvantage levels was deemed to be complicated for mainstream schools, resulting in confusion

gen_risks.description: Schools may fail to meet required food standards, leading to regulatory breaches.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deliver food‑standards training, supply approved menu templates, and conduct compliance audits.
gen_risks.evidence: Food provided must be in line with school food standards

gen_risks.description: Procurement delays for additional advisers could limit support for schools during rollout.
gen_risks.mitigation: Use existing framework contracts to fast‑track recruitment, set strict procurement timelines, and monitor progress closely.
gen_risks.evidence: procurement process to increase the number of advisers supporting schools through the educational and children's social care framework

gt_risks.description: Lower value for money compared to the 'do minimum' option in year 1, due to the shorter funding period available for the preferred option's new cohorts of schools.
Delivery risks around staffing and food costs for schools newly onboarded to the free breakfast clubs programme.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated through early adopter (EA) scheme insights and support funding.

gt_risks.description: Uncertainty in the labour-market benefits (parental workforce participation gains) the programme is expected to deliver.
gt_risks.mitigation: Addressed through conservative assumptions in the economic modelling.
